name: Rapid Dual-Shape Reversible Memory Enhancement

name: Multiple-Shape Reversible Shift for 3D Intelligent Devices
description: This transformation enables 3D printed objects to shift between multiple shapes in a reversible manner, offering designers the ability to create intelligent devices with dynamic, reconfigurable forms.

name: Dual-Shape Two-Way Reversible NiTi Design
description: The transformation allows the design of 3D printed smart structures that can shift between two distinct shapes in a two-way reversible manner, providing enhanced functionality for adaptive products and devices.

name: One-Way Reversible Precipitation-Hardened Transformation
description: This transformation allows for the creation of high-strength, one-way reversible 3D printed steel structures, where the material hardens over time after initial shaping, making it ideal for products requiring enhanced durability without additional processing.

name: Multiple-Shape Two-Way Reversible Self-Forming Textile
description: This transformation allows 4D textiles to autonomously change between a permanent and multiple temporary shapes under thermal stimulation, enabling flexible and adaptive product designs such as wrist supports.

name: Dual-Shape Two-Way Reversible Auxetic Design
description: This transformation allows auxetic structures to shift between two distinct shapes in both directions (reversible), enabling dynamic and programmable designs for products that adapt to various stimuli, such as temperature changes.

name: Dual-Shape One-Way Reversible Magnetic Response
description: This transformation enables 3D printed objects to exhibit a one-way reversible change in shape and functionality when subjected to external magnetic fields, making it ideal for soft robots and smart actuators.

name: Dual-Shape Remote-Controlled One-Way Reversible Transformation
description: This transformation allows objects to shift between two shapes in a one-way reversible manner, controlled remotely through temperature-induced magnetic fields, making it ideal for smart products in fields like medicine where remote manipulation is critical.

name: Dual-Shape One-Way Reversible Transformation for High-Elongation PETG-PBAT Blends
description: The transformation enables the printed objects to shift between two shapes in a one-way reversible manner, offering designers flexibility in creating products with high elongation and toughness, especially useful for functional components that require temporary shape changes.

name: Dual-Shape One-Way Reversible Composite for Automotive and Aerospace
description: This transformation allows 3D printed PVC-PP composite objects to shift between two distinct shapes in a one-way reversible manner, enhancing their application in automotive and aerospace sectors where temporary deformation and recovery are needed.

name: Accelerated Dual-Shape Reversible Photopolymerization
description: This transformation enables fast production of dual-shape one-way reversible parts by reducing curing time with nanosilica, making the process more efficient without compromising material recovery.

name: Rapid Multi-SMP Digital Light Fabrication
description: The process enables the rapid production of 3D printed objects with multiple-shape reversible transformations, using digital light modulation to control material properties and complete printing within 30 seconds.

name: Graded Dual-Shape Two-Way Reversible Laser-Tuned Process
description: This transformation process enables precise control over two-way reversible dual-shape behavior in NiTi SMAs by tuning the phase transformation and mechanical properties through laser power adjustments during the printing process.

name: In-Situ One-Way Reversible Precipitation via Laser Additive Manufacturing
description: The process leverages in-situ one-way reversible transformations where time-dependent material properties evolve during laser additive manufacturing, eliminating the need for post-heat treatments and streamlining production.

name: FDM-Based Two-Way Reversible Textile Manufacturing
description: This process enables efficient manufacturing of textiles that exhibit two-way reversible transformations, leveraging thermal responsiveness to eliminate traditional thermomechanical programming steps and reduce production time.

name: Dual-Step Two-Way Reversible TME Fabrication
description: The process enables the creation of dual-shape, two-way reversible transformations using the Temperature Memory Effect (TME), allowing precise control over shape recovery in auxetic grids across different temperature stages, enhancing manufacturing efficiency for tunable mechanical properties.

name: Magnetic Field-Assisted Dual-Shape One-Way Reversible Printing
description: The process allows the fabrication of dual-shape one-way reversible structures using magnetic field-assisted 4D printing, ensuring high spatial resolution and superior anisotropic magnetic properties in printed objects.

name: Granule-Based FDM with One-Way Reversible Shape Memory
description: The process enables efficient fabrication of nanocomposites with dual-shape one-way reversible capabilities, using granule-based FDM printing with pneumatic control to address the challenges of nanoparticle integration and precise geometry control.

name: Dual-Shape One-Way Reversible Melt Flow-Controlled Printing
description: This process enables the production of dual-shape one-way reversible parts by optimizing melt flow control during 3D printing, resulting in excellent printability and uniform mechanical properties with enhanced shape memory performance.

name: One-Way Reversible Shape Memory Filament Production for FFF
description: The process uses twin-screw compounding to produce PVC-PP filaments with one-way reversible shape memory properties, enabling efficient and flexible fused filament fabrication for sectors like biomedical and textiles.

name: Nanosilica-Enhanced Dual-Shape Reversible SMP Composite
description: By introducing nanosilica into shape memory polymers, the materials exhibit a dual-shape one-way reversible transformation, enhancing their mechanical strength and shape recovery.

name: Spatio-Temporally Tuned Multiple-Shape Reversible SMP
description: This transformation involves SMPs with multiple-shape reversible behavior, achieved through precise control of transition temperature, elongation, and modulus, enabling advanced functionality for photonic and electronic devices.

name: Two-Way Reversible Phase Transformation in NiTi Alloys
description: The transformation involves controlling two-way reversible phase transitions (from B2 to B19′ phases) in NiTi SMAs, resulting in enhanced mechanical properties like tensile strength and elongation through laser-induced grain refinement and micropore filling.

name: One-Way Reversible Precipitation-Hardened Fe-Ni-Ti-Al Steel
description: This material undergoes a one-way reversible transformation through in-situ precipitation hardening during 3D printing, allowing for superior mechanical properties like increased tensile strength without additional thermal treatments.

name: PLA-Lycra Two-Way Reversible Composite Behavior
description: The material exhibits two-way reversible transformations between permanent and temporary shapes, where thinner PLA and greater Lycra elongation lead to more pronounced curvatures in the final form under thermal stimuli.

name: Hierarchical Two-Way Reversible Shape Memory Transformation
description: This transformation utilizes the temperature memory effect (TME) to achieve two-way reversible shape changes, allowing auxetic structures to remember both their original shape and the deformation temperature, enabling complex, programmable behaviors over a wide range of temperatures.

name: Anisotropic Magnetic Dual-Shape One-Way Reversible SMP
description: The material transformation enables dual-shape one-way reversible behavior with strong anisotropic magnetic properties, achieved by integrating soft magnetic iron particles with flexible resin, making it ideal for responsive metamaterials and smart sensors.

name: Magnetically-Activated One-Way Reversible Shape Memory Nanocomposites
description: The nanocomposites exhibit dual-shape one-way reversible transformation, with iron oxide enhancing the shape-memory effect, heat transfer, and remote recovery, while balancing mechanical properties like tensile strength and elongation.

name: Dual-Shape One-Way Reversible PETG-PBAT Composite with Enhanced Shape Memory
description: The transformation enables one-way reversible shape changes by tuning the PETG-PBAT blend, where increasing PBAT content lowers the transition temperature and strengthens the elastic properties, allowing faster and more efficient shape recovery.

name: PVC-PP Composite One-Way Reversible Shape Recovery
description: The transformation involves one-way reversible shape recovery in PVC-PP composites, where the best shape memory behavior is observed in neat PVC, making it suitable for applications demanding temporary deformation with gradual recovery.
